correctness.rationale: Stationary Gaussian Markov bridge conditioning gives independent conditional-integral gap residuals, with exact terminal b(x)=2x−3+4e^(−x)−e^(−2x) and interior v(x)=2x−4tanh(x/2). Strict convexity bʺ,vʺ>0 for x>0 forces equal interior gaps h and equal terminal margins a>0; bʹ(λa)=vʹ(λh) yields a=h/2+λ⁻¹log cosh(λh/2) and n h+2λ⁻¹log cosh(λh/2)=1. Cubic b≈2x³/3, v≈x³/6 imply optimal n²V→σ²λ/6. Independent uniform jitters yield 1-dependent Y=(1+U_{i+1}−U_i)^3 with E=3/2, Var=16/7, lag-one Cov=−307/336, long-run 11/24; its CLT yields 11σ⁴λ²/864 after normalization. Independent 30 Schur-complement/covariance cases, 4 exact cubic moments and 12 optimum stationarity cases agree.
residual_risks: Gaussian-process Markov property and standard bounded 1-dependent CLT are invoked; all n with σ²,λ fixed, noiseless integral observations.
